找到 LearnKu 那篇分析技术论坛复兴的文章，还有小众软件（appinn）。抓原文。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const urls = [
 "https://learnku.com/articles/93698",
 "https://meta.appinn.net/t/topic/60889/7",
 "https://pandafiredoge.freeflarum.com/d/90-kan-dao-zui-jin-you-chu-lai-liao-ge-linuxsbye-shi-zhan-chang-bu-zuo-wei-xian-zai-chu-xian-ge-chong-wen-ti-ye-bu-gai-kan-shang-qu-liang-liang-shi-chi-zao-de-shi/25",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "let i=0;",
 "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
 "async function next(){",
 " if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
 " const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " await sleep(i===1?2000:9000);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',async function(){",
 " let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
 " b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
 " b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/“/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/”/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/…/g,'...').replace(/—/g,'-');",
 " b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
 " console.log('===== '+u.substring(0,60)+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
 " console.log(b.substring(0,5000));",
 " await next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+u.substring(0,60)+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-alt13.cjs", content: js });

const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch forum revival analysis and bounty threads", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 16000));

const urls = [
  "https://learnku.com/articles/93698",
  "https://meta.appinn.net/t/topic/60889/7",
  "https://pandafiredoge.freeflarum.com/d/90-kan-dao-zui-jin-you-chu-lai-liao-ge-linuxsbye-shi-zhan-chang-bu-zuo-wei-xian-zai-chu-xian-ge-chong-wen-ti-ye-bu-gai-kan-shang-qu-liang-liang-shi-chi-zao-de-shi/25",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
  "  const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  await sleep(i===1?2000:9000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/“/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/”/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/…/g,'...').replace(/—/g,'-');",
  "      b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+u.substring(0,60)+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,5000));",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+u.substring(0,60)+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-alt13.cjs", content: js });
